notes:
Compound of ⟦{鉄|てつ}→鉄：02225_tetsu⟧ (iron/steel) and {骨|こつ} (bone/frame). Refers to the steel structural members used in building construction. Very common in real estate listings and construction contexts in Japan, where building structure type is a standard piece of information.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鉄骨|てっこつ}{造|づく}り: steel-frame construction
- {鉄骨|てっこつ}⟦{鉄筋|てっきん}コンクリート→鉄筋コンクリート：17904_tekkinkonkuriito⟧{造|づく}り: steel-reinforced concrete (SRC)
- {鉄骨|てっこつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}む→組む：02050_kumu⟧: to assemble steel frames
- {鉄骨|てっこつ}⟦{構造|こうぞう}→構造：02730_kouzou⟧: steel structure

BUILDING STRUCTURE TYPES:
Japanese real estate commonly abbreviates these as:
- S{造|ぞう}: steel ({鉄骨|てっこつ})
- RC{造|ぞう}: reinforced concrete (⟦{鉄筋|てっきん}コンクリート→鉄筋コンクリート：17904_tekkinkonkuriito⟧)
- SRC{造|ぞう}: steel-reinforced concrete ({鉄骨|てっこつ}⟦{鉄筋|てっきん}コンクリート→鉄筋コンクリート：17904_tekkinkonkuriito⟧)
- W{造|ぞう}: wood (⟦{木造|もくぞう}→木造：08328_mokuzou⟧)
